module_summary: Direct-mapped write-through cache: a 5-state FSM latches CPU requests, compares tag/valid arrays for hit, refills or writes memory via req/ack, then responds.

anchors.name: state_q
anchors.why: IDLE/LOOKUP/WRITE_MEM/REFILL/RESPOND controller driving handshakes, array writes and memory requests.

anchors.name: data_array
anchors.why: 16-line data store, refilled from mem_rdata or updated by write hits.

anchors.name: tag_array
anchors.why: Per-line tag store written on refill, compared for hit.

anchors.name: cpu_req_valid
anchors.why: CPU request valid; in IDLE latches address/data/we and starts lookup.

anchors.name: cpu_rdata
anchors.why: Response data from rdata_q: hit data, refill data or write data.

anchors.name: mem_req
anchors.why: Memory request asserted in REFILL and WRITE_MEM states.

anchors.name: mem_ack
anchors.why: Memory acknowledge completing refill/write; triggers array updates and RESPOND.

anchors.name: hit
anchors.why: Valid bit and tag match; selects RESPOND vs REFILL and gates write-hit update.

anchors.name: valid_bits
anchors.why: Per-line valid bits set on refill, qualify hit.

anchors.name: addr_q
anchors.why: Latched request address held across miss; supplies index, tag and mem_addr.

anchors.name: cpu_req_ready
anchors.why: Ready to accept CPU request, asserted only in IDLE.

anchors.name: index
anchors.why: Line index from addr_q addressing tag, data and valid arrays.

anchors.name: tag
anchors.why: Tag field of addr_q compared with tag_array and written on refill.

anchors.name: wdata_q
anchors.why: Latched write data driving mem_wdata and write-hit array update.

anchors.name: we_q
anchors.why: Latched write command selecting WRITE_MEM path in LOOKUP.

anchors.name: cpu_we
anchors.why: Read/write command of the CPU request, latched into we_q.

anchors.name: mem_rdata
anchors.why: Refill data written into data_array and rdata_q.

anchors.name: stall_o
anchors.why: Busy level while FSM in LOOKUP, WRITE_MEM or REFILL.

groups.name: Cache controller FSM
groups.description: Sequences lookup, write-through, refill and respond; drives CPU and memory handshakes.

groups.name: Tag and data arrays
groups.description: Direct-mapped tag/data/valid storage indexed by addr_q, hit compare.

groups.name: Request latches
groups.description: Holds request address/data and response data rdata_q across miss handling.

groups.name: Memory port
groups.description: Req/ack memory bus for refills and write-through.

groups.name: CPU port
groups.description: CPU request inputs latched in IDLE.
